items.title: New rules for hurling to be trialled in October
items.summary: A number rule changes in hurling will be trialled from next month following an interim report published by the GAA's hurling expert advisory group.
items.titleZh: 新的投掷规则将于10月试行
items.summaryZh: 在GAA投掷专家咨询小组发布中期报告后，将从下个月开始试行投掷规则的一些变化。

items.title: Secret Service Freezes $52.8 Million in Crypto Tied to Telegram Bazaar Behind Global Scams
items.summary: Blockchain sleuths at Elliptic traced the money, Treasury sanctioned the marketplace, and Xinbi—which ran $24 billion through a Telegram scam bazaar—called the freeze unfair.
items.titleZh: 特勤局冻结了全球骗局背后与Telegram Bazaar有关的5280万美元加密货币
items.summaryZh: Elliptic的区块链侦探追踪了这笔钱，财政部批准了该市场，而通过Telegram骗局集市运营240亿美元的Xinbi称冻结是不公平的。

items.title: How beauty giant Estee Lauder’s top technologist is betting on ‘AI everywhere’ to fuel its turnaround
items.summary: This week, the M.A.C and Clinique maker announced that Brian Franz—who oversees data, technology, and analytics—will take on an expanded role on the C-suite.
items.titleZh: 美容巨头雅诗兰黛的顶尖技术专家如何押注“无处不在的人工智能”来推动其扭亏为盈
items.summaryZh: 本周，M.A.C和倩碧的制造商宣布，负责数据、技术和分析的Brian Franz将在最高管理层中担任更重要的角色。

items.title: This CEO isn’t sure about financial nihilism, but he’s horrified by sports gambling online. So this football season, he’ll pay you not to do it
items.summary: Acorns CEO Noah Kerner doesn't know if Gen Z has given up on getting rich the old-fashioned way. But he's convinced Americans have a problem.
items.titleZh: 这位首席执行官对金融虚无主义并不确定，但他对网上体育赌博感到震惊。所以这个足球赛季，他会付钱让你不要这样做
items.summaryZh: Acorns首席执行官诺亚·科纳不知道Z世代是否已经放弃了老式的致富方式。但他确信美国人有问题。

items.title: BofA flags 3 ways agentic AI tools are reshaping the investing landscape
items.summary: Agentic AI has become available to retail and institutional traders alike, and a divergence is being seen among brokerages that offer AI tools, BofA says.
items.titleZh: 美国银行指出了代理人工智能工具重塑投资格局的三种方式
items.summaryZh: 美国银行表示，代理人工智能已可供零售和机构交易员使用，提供人工智能工具的券商之间也出现了分歧。

items.title: Alex Gibney's Elon Musk documentary goes for the jugular in these 3 scenes
items.summary: Alex Gibney's Elon Musk documentary is a hard-hitting examination of Tesla, AI, and his relationships with women like Ashley St. Clair.
items.titleZh: 亚历克斯·吉布尼的埃隆·马斯克纪录片在这三个场景中直击要害
items.summaryZh: 亚历克斯·吉布尼（Alex Gibney）的埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）纪录片对特斯拉、人工智能以及他与阿什利·圣克莱尔（Ashley St.Clair）等女性的关系进行了严厉的审视。

items.title: EVgo is adding 400+ fast chargers where you grocery shop
items.summary:
EVgo is adding more than 400 fast-charging stalls at grocery-anchored shopping centers across the US, giving EV drivers more places to plug in while they shop or grab a coffee.



 more…
items.titleZh: EVgo在杂货店增加了400多个快速充电器
items.summaryZh: EVgo正在美国各地的杂货店购物中心增加400多个快速充电摊位，为电动汽车司机在购物或喝咖啡时提供更多的充电场所。

items.title: Hunter Biden's LAPTOP Meme Coin Crashes 99% on Debut
items.summary: LAPTOP hit a $190.81 peak within minutes of launching on Base, then shed roughly 99% as thin liquidity met a wave of selling.
items.titleZh: 亨特·拜登的笔记本电脑迷因币首次亮相暴跌99%
items.summaryZh: 笔记本电脑在Base上推出后几分钟内就达到了190.81美元的峰值，然后由于流动性不足引发了一波抛售，股价下跌了约99%。

items.title: Anthropic researcher resigns, warning that AI companies are “gambling with our lives”
items.summary: Departing Anthropic researcher is not the first to warn AI labs are racing towards catastrophe. But this time, key staff members still at Anthropic publicly endorsed the view—with one putting the chance of AI causing human extinction at more than 10%.
items.titleZh: Anthropic研究人员辞职，警告人工智能公司正在“拿我们的生活赌博”
items.summaryZh: 即将离任的Anthropic研究人员并不是第一个警告人工智能实验室正在走向灾难的人。但这一次，Anthropic的主要工作人员公开支持这一观点，其中一人认为人工智能导致人类灭绝的可能性超过10%。

items.title: Microsoft, AFT unveil AI safety and privacy standard for schools

items.titleZh: 微软，AFT公布学校人工智能安全和隐私标准
items.summaryZh: 微软和美国教师联合会（AFT）周三公布了一项新的学校人工智能安全和隐私标准，此前美国最大的两个学区对人工智能的使用施加了严格的新限制。国家标准禁止学生和教育工作者…
